mapper.update: MERGE INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_INBOX T USING (SELECT #{hash} PAYLOAD_HASH FROM DUAL) S ON (T.PAYLOAD_HASH = S.PAYLOAD_HASH) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (PAYLOAD_HASH, PAYLOAD, RECEIVED_DT) VALUES (S.PAYLOAD_HASH, #{payload,jdbcType=CLOB}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RESULT_INBOX SET ERROR_REASON = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PAYLOAD_HASH = #{hash}
